snippet.title: Marvel Rivals - Official The Hood Character Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss The Hood Character Reveal Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit action hero-shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players will attack from the shadows as Parker Robbins, a man cursed with The Hood. Dish out damage with his iconic dual pistols and unleash the demon as The Hood in Marvel Rivals, launching on August 7 with Season 9.5 on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
